snippet_primary: "Over the years, she'd stayed silent about her lack of rights over her course. Plus, her affiliate link that gave her 75% commission as opposed to the 25% (if they signed up through Domestika) kept changing or breaking (which she believed was intentional). These student discounts barely earned her $10-$15 every month. She felt helpless because her primary contact had stopped responding to her emails."
subject_exact: Domestika instructor affiliate commission 75% vs 25% through Domestika direct; affiliate link instability earning $10-$15 monthly
parser_notes: Class Central report. Two commission structures: 75% via instructor affiliate link, 25% via Domestika direct. Instructor believed link breakage was intentional.
